## Summary
- Why now? (problem, motivation, or context)

## Changes
- Concrete files, behavior, or configuration touched.

## Scope
- [ ] Code
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] CI/Tooling
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Dependencies

## Testing
List exact commands/checks run and outcomes.

## Compatibility / risks
- Breaking changes:
- Security impact:
- Performance impact:
- Rollback plan:

## Related issue
- `Fixes #…` / `Closes #…` / `Related to #…` when tracking requires it.
  Do not put those references in source-code comments.

## Checklist
- [ ] Changes are scoped and reviewable
- [ ] Tests added/updated where practical
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Changelog updated
- [ ] No AI-tool attribution, assistant `Co-authored-by`, or personal emails in contributor text
